title: BUGFIX — 15s videos always fail QC: only 5 pattern interrupts but gate requires >= 8
rationale: buildPatternInterrupts uses a fixed 2.5s interval. For a 15s video this yields 5 interrupts (at 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5s). QC gate checkVisualChangeCadence requires >= 8 interrupts — 15s videos 100% fail QC. Fix: dynamic interval = Math.min(2.5, totalDuration/9) ensures >= 9 interrupts for 15s, unchanged for 30s and 60s.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-script/index.ts buildPatternInterrupts: change fixed 2.5s interval to Math.min(2.5, totalDuration/9) to guarantee >= 9 interrupts for all video durations.
